method: Each 16-byte PLT stub is 'jmp *GOT(%rip); push imm32; jmp resolver'. The pushed imm32 is the index into analysis.json 'imports'. NID (before '#') joined to analysis/import-names.json for names (analysis.json import_name_hints as fallback) and to missing-imports.txt for implemented=false. Stub region scanned 0x10fcbd0-0x1100000. Validated: 0x10fdb90=252 sceNetCtlInit, 0x10fe210=356, 0x10fe220=357, 0x10fe2e0=369 match known values.
